delivery.description: The delivery ULID. Matches X-Tmesis-Delivery. Duplicated in the body so a receiver that logs bodies has the dedupe key without the headers.

occurred_at.description: RFC3339 UTC, when the event happened on the node. ORDER BY THIS, never by arrival: delivery is unordered.

session.description: The session this recording belongs to. As built one recording_id is one file in one session; a hold closes it (reason input_lost) and the rejoin opens the next part under a new recording_id in the same session. Correlate on recording_id.

reason.description: CLOSED set: what ended the capture. input_lost is the part closed when the publisher left and the session was held (final plan 11.38): the file is complete and clean to that point, and a rejoin opens the next part as its own row. Added 2026-09-18, additive like the flv container widening. master_finished (tmesis v0.8.0, D37) is the told master's remux having made its MP4; it is the only reason a master's recording.completed carries.

parts.description: Always 1: one row is one file and nothing is stitched (final plan 11.34 D4, 11.38). A rejoin after a hold opens a new row rather than a longer file, so this never counts a session's parts.

container.description: The finalized container. For the ingest artifact it is ALWAYS the capture container (mpegts or flv): the ingest copy is never remuxed, at capture or at finalize (final plan 11.34 D1). mp4 is the told master, a faststart MP4 joined from its sources (since v0.8.0).

capture_container.description: What it was written as while live; for the told master, its sources' capture container.

dropped_bytes_total.description: Non-zero means writes were shed, the file is incomplete, and a recording.degraded explained why.

duration_seconds.description: Wall clock from open to close for the ingest artifact (neither container is parsed), so a file with shed writes reads a FULL duration here and a shorter one in a player; dropped_bytes_total is the number that says so.

checksum_sha256.description: Of the finalized file as written locally, so the destination copy can be verified independently.

destination.description: The stream's effective directory at finalize. null means local, or held on a destination_ref (WEBHOOKS.md 8.14).

retention_expires_at.description: ALWAYS null on this event. Retention counts from registration, never from finalize, and nothing is registered yet; recording.registered (8.14) carries the real value. The schema pins this with const:null so a receiver that mistakenly trusted a timestamp would learn at the schema, not at 3am.

source_generations.description: The told master's source generations (recording_ingest) in join order. Always [] for the ingest artifact.
